comparison.objective: Reassemble a fan: keyed blade insertion, threaded spinner tightening, and grille clipping; not material separation.
comparison.physical_skill: Sequential alignment, insertion, counterholding, rotation, and clip actuation versus bimanual sieve agitation and size-selective retention.
comparison.success_condition: Blade keyed, spinner tight, grille clipped, hands clear, 1 s stillness; no recovery fraction or passage-through-aperture requirement.
comparison.reason: Tests multi-stage appliance assembly, not selective many-body separation.
